verdict.rationale: Docs clearly describe linking bank/card/payroll accounts with continuous, automatic daily reconciliation and categorization, backed by a launch post detailing real-time import ('pulled in automatically... reconciles in real time'). Mercury itself notes automation has limits (not full 'autopilot'), which is a scope caveat rather than contradiction. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification beyond vendor claims, and detail on frequency/reliability guarantees for the daily import cadence.
